resources.string: Use Wi-Fi if you can: one file of %1$d MB, downloaded once. Names and words work right away. Meaning search gets better as %2$s learns, best after a night on the charger.
Already have the file? Choose it from your phone.
%1$s adds the file by itself when it finishes downloading, once you allow access to your files. Or use Choose the file.
%1$s adds the file by itself when the download finishes. You can start now.
No browser was found on this phone. Copy the file onto it another way, then choose it here.
The models are installed. Search is ready.
Remove the downloaded file to free %1$s?
This file is for a different kind of phone. Use Get the models to download the one for this phone.
The file is damaged or incomplete, so %1$s did not use it. Download it again, then try again.
The download stopped before it finished. Tap Get the models to start it again.
The file could not be opened. Check that it is still on your phone, then try again.
%1$s could not confirm that this file is genuine, so it did not use it. Use Get the models to download it again.
This file is older than the models already on this phone, so %1$s kept the newer ones.
There is not enough free space on this phone. Free up about %1$d MB, then try again.
Best search in every language, speech in videos and voice notes.
English search just as good; Luganda and Swahili photo search weaker; no speech in videos or voice notes. You can add the rest later.
You have the Save data pack. English search is just as good; Luganda and Swahili photo search is weaker, and videos and voice notes are not read for speech.
You have the Standard pack: the best search in every language, and speech in videos and voice notes.

Adding the Standard pack makes %1$s read your files again with the better model. Your list of files stays: searching by file name and finding photos by quick look keep working meanwhile. Words inside documents and screenshots, and search by meaning, come back as each file is read again, best while the phone charges.

The Standard pack is installed. Close %1$s and open it again to start using it. It then reads your files again with the better model. File names and quick photo search keep working meanwhile; words inside documents and screenshots come back as files are read.
Adding it makes %1$s read your files again. That happens while the phone charges, and search keeps working meanwhile.
Adding it does not make %1$s read your files again.
